mapper.select: SELECT vp.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(uvp.custom_name, ''), vp.name) AS name, vp.provider_voice_id, vp.avatar_url, vp.gender, vp.age_group, vp.status, vp.sort_no, vp.created_at, vp.updated_at FROM ts_user_voice_profile uvp INNER JOIN ts_voice_profile vp ON vp.id = uvp.voice_profile_id WHERE uvp.user_id = #{userId} AND uvp.voice_profile_id = #{voiceProfileId} AND uvp.status != 0 AND vp.status != 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ts_user_voice_profile ( user_id, voice_profile_id, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{voiceProfileId}, 1, #{now}, #{now} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 1, updated_at = #{now}
